mapper.select: /*getCategoriList*/ SELECT A.STD_CATEG_ID -- 카테고리번호[0] , A.CATEG_NAME , A.CATEG_NAME CATEG_NAME_REAL , A.CATEG_TYPE --[2] , A.CATEG_SYS_CODE , A.PID , DECODE ( A.CATEG_TYPE, 'REG', '', ' (' || (SELECT COUNT (DISTINCT C.BUYER_ITEM_NO) FROM ICOMBYIT B, ICOMCQDT C WHERE B.BUYER = C.BUYER AND B.BUYER_ITEM_NO = C.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND B.STATUS <> 'D' AND C.STATUS <> 'D' AND B.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG IN ('N', 'Y') AND C.BELOW_COMORG_CODE = DECODE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M180' AND FLAG = 'Y' AND CODE = #{param4}), 0, #{param4}, C.BELOW_COMORG_CODE) AND B.BUYER = A.COM_CODE AND B.CATEGORY_NO = A.STD_CATEG_ID) || ')') AS CNT --[3] FROM ICOMBYCA A WHERE A.COM_CODE = (SELECT DECODE(USING_CATAL_TYPE, 'A', BYCA_COMORG_CODE --A :전용 , 'C', BYCA_COMORG_CODE --C : 둘다 , 'KRCOMMG001' ) BYCA_COMORG_CODE --하드코딩 FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = #{param4} --param4 : 고객사 com_code ) AND A.DEPTH = #{param2} --param2 AND A.STATUS <> 'D' AND A.PID = DECODE(#{param2}, 1, (SELECT STD_CATEG_ID FROM ICOMBYCA WHERE COM_CODE = A.COM_CODE --param1 : 고객사 byca_comorg_code AND DEPTH = 0 AND STATUS <> 'D' ) --최상위 레벨(대분류)인경우 , #{param3} --param3 : 선택한 카테고리 ) ORDER BY A.CATEG_SYS_CODE

/*getCategoriList2*/ SELECT A.STD_CATEG_ID -- 카테고리번호[0] , A.CATEG_NAME --[1] , A.CATEG_NAME CATEG_NAME_REAL , A.CATEG_TYPE --[2] , A.CATEG_SYS_CODE , A.PID , DECODE ( A.CATEG_TYPE, 'REG', '', ' (' || (SELECT COUNT (DISTINCT C.BUYER_ITEM_NO) FROM ICOMBYIT B, ICOMCQDT C WHERE B.BUYER = C.BUYER AND B.BUYER_ITEM_NO = C.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND B.STATUS <> 'D' AND C.STATUS <> 'D' AND B.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG IN ('N', 'Y') AND C.BELOW_COMORG_CODE = DECODE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M180' AND FLAG = 'Y' AND CODE = #{param4}), 0, #{param4}, C.BELOW_COMORG_CODE) AND B.BUYER = A.COM_CODE AND B.CATEGORY_NO = A.STD_CATEG_ID) || ')') AS CNT --[3] FROM ICOMBYCA A WHERE A.COM_CODE = (SELECT DECODE(USING_CATAL_TYPE, 'A', BYCA_COMORG_CODE --A :전용 , 'C', BYCA_COMORG_CODE --C : 둘다 , 'KRCOMMG001' ) BYCA_COMORG_CODE --하드코딩 FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = #{param4} --param4 : 고객사 com_code ) AND A.DEPTH = #{param2} --param2 AND A.STATUS <> 'D' AND A.PID = DECODE(#{param2}, 1, (SELECT STD_CATEG_ID FROM ICOMBYCA WHERE COM_CODE = A.COM_CODE --param1 : 고객사 byca_comorg_code AND DEPTH = 0 AND STATUS <> 'D' ) --최상위 레벨(대분류)인경우 , #{param3} --param3 : 선택한 카테고리 ) AND A.STD_CATEG_ID IN ( SELECT DISTINCT STD_CATEG_ID FROM ( SELECT STD_CATEG_ID FROM ICOMBYCA A, ICOMCOD3 B WHERE A.COM_CODE=B.BUYER AND A.COM_CODE = #{param1} AND A.COM_CODE = B.TEXT1 AND B.TYPE = #{type} AND B.CODE1 = #{param5} AND B.FLAG = 'Y' AND SUBSTR(A.CATEG_SYS_CODE,1,8) = B.TEXT2 UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT STD_CATEG_ID FROM ICOMBYCA A WHERE A.COM_CODE = #{param1} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ICOMCOD3 B WHERE B.BUYER = A.COM_CODE AND B.TEXT1 = A.COM_CODE AND B.TEXT2 = SUBSTR(A.CATEG_SYS_CODE,1,8) AND B.TYPE = #{type} AND B.FLAG = 'Y' ) ) ) ORDER BY A.CATEG_SYS_CODE

/*getStdCategoriList*/ SELECT DISTINCT A.CATEG_SYS_CODE,A.CATEG_NAME , A.STD_CATEG_ID FROM ( SELECT CATEG_SYS_CODE, CATEG_NAME,STD_CATEG_ID, PID FROM ICOMBYCA WHERE COM_CODE=#{param1} --param1 AND DEPTH <> 0 ) A CONNECT BY PRIOR A.PID = A.STD_CATEG_ID START WITH A.STD_CATEG_ID = #{param2} --param2 ORDER BY A.CATEG_SYS_CODE
